input: The QNC root and the applications available in the desktop (application id, tab, priority group).
output: The tabs the launch bar shows: without an active project only the first priority group; with one only the applications of its stored sequence, in its order. Read again from the project database on every call.
specification: User rule 2026-10-01 (v5 workspace.tabs): the launch bar is tied to the project settings in the database.
